onboarding.overhaul.search.body.old: Chats, characters and guides you open become tabs up here. Press **+** or **{{mod}}+K** anywhere to find or open anything, change a setting, run a command, or ask me a question.
onboarding.overhaul.search.body.new: Chats, characters and guides you open become tabs up here. Click the magnifier or press **{{mod}}+K** anywhere to find or open anything, change a setting, run a command, or ask me a question.
